title: LoomDiagnosticsReconciliationAndRecovery
clause: Deliver Loom health, drift detection, reconciliation, repair and no-context recovery across all recovered semantic families.

current_source_discovery: Inspect accepted diagnostics, EventLedger, outbox, projection registry, search-index and native health surfaces.
Enumerate every failure, never-started, partial-success, restart and corruption state owned by MT-385 through MT-390.
stop_conditions: Repair would write from a derived projection back into canonical authority without source reconciliation.
Diagnostics expose project content or use administrative credentials as privacy proof.

scope.summary: Make Loom failures observable and repairable by an operator or no-context model. Canonical Surreal state and EventLedger are reconciled against derived indexes, relations, projections and UI state; repair never invents domain data.
forbidden_paths: Repair from UI cache or search index as authority
Automatic destructive repair without preview and receipt
acceptance_criteria: Diagnostics expose privacy-safe Loom schema, EventLedger/outbox, relation, projection-registry, search-index, live-query and repair health with stable typed status codes.
Reconciliation detects missing/stale/duplicate projections, dangling relations, index drift, orphaned tombstones and version incompatibilities by rereading canonical Surreal state.
Repairs are dry-run previewable, bounded, idempotent, attributable and independently verified by a fresh Surreal reread before success is reported.
Crash, cancellation, restart and partial-failure tests prove repair resumes or rolls back without changing canonical domain authority.
Native diagnostics show healthy, degraded, blocked, repairing, recovered and failed states with actionable recovery steps and stable Argus identifiers.
proof_targets: Inject each classified drift/failure into real disposable SurrealDB and prove detection, preview, repair, restart and reread.
Run record-user privacy tests for diagnostics and repair controls.
Run Argus diagnostics/recovery state matrix and no-context UserManual recovery exercise.

same_project_private_resource_cases: Health aggregates and repair previews do not reveal another member's private resources.
cross_account_negative_cases: Forged project/repair IDs cannot inspect or repair another account.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Reports, traces and receipts contain only scope-safe identifiers and aggregates.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Active repair cancels or pins an explicit authorized context; stale controls fail closed.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Remote projection failures do not expose remote credentials or imply local authorization.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Counts, source kinds, paths, titles, errors and timing are privacy-safe.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.evidence: diagnosis, preview, repair, retry, denial and reread verdict events
complete Loom health taxonomy and actionable status codes
crash/freeze capture, bounded recovery and no-context reproduction bundle

risk_if_missed: Recovered Loom features can silently drift after restart or partial failure, leaving operators and models unable to distinguish canonical state from stale projections.

risks: A partial repair is reported successful.

sources: Official SurrealDB backup/recovery and transaction documentation
research_provenance.selected_approach: Canonical-reread reconciliation with previewable idempotent repair and complete three-tier diagnostics.
